name: Khubayb ibn Adi
bio: Khubayb ibn Adi belonged to the Aws of Medina. Ibn Abd al-Barr lists him among those who fought at Badr. Captured at al-Raji, he was sold in Mecca and taken outside the sanctuary to be killed. Al-Bukhari relates that he asked to pray two units of prayer and recited two verses about dying a Muslim. Ibn Ishaq preserves a longer poem for the occasion, whose attribution Ibn Hisham says some authorities disputed.
